entities.summary: Isabel Buarque de Hollanda Gilberto de Oliveira, known as Bebel Gilberto, is a Brazilian popular singer often associated with bossa nova. She is the daughter of João Gilberto and singer Miúcha. Her uncle is singer and composer Chico Buarque. Bebel Gilberto was a composers & musicians from Manhattan (b. 1966-05-12, Manhattan). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
